messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: INC-2026 fired for inference-gateway-prod (eu-west1) — 5xx rate > 6% (5m window) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026 — triggered by policy 'inference-gateway:5xx-rate'
Samir P: on call, ack'd in PD. I'm taking lead. starting quick triage — pinging @Jordan SRE and @Alex C
pd-bot: Acknowledged by Samir P (on-call). Auto-escalation paused.
Jordan SRE: can you post a quick blast radius? is this cluster-wide or single pool?
Alex C: seeing 502/503 surge on gateway-proxy-eu-3 podset. error rate concentrated on /v1/generate route, seq len 1024+ mostly.
Alex C: logs show upstream worker pool returning 'connection reset by peer' and 'kv cache miss flood' around same time. copying sample:```[2026-03-15T02:40:12Z] proxy: upstream reset id=abc123 worker=pool-eu-3 code=ECONNRESET```
Maria G: interesting — we've got a warmup job for model-large that might be thrashing memory, causing evictions. any recent deploys?
Samir P: no deploys in past 30m per deploy-bot. last deploy 2 hours ago.
Jordan SRE: ok runbook: 1) scope traffic, 2) divert new requests to fallback model variant, 3) drain pool-eu-3, 4) warm caches on healthy pools.
Alex C: preparing a routing override now — will split traffic 80/20 to fallback (model-large-quant-small) to keep latency bounds.
Alex C: command:```POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/routing/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","region":"eu-west1","split":[{"target":"model-large-quant","pct":20},{"target":"model-medium","pct":80}]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'```
Maria G: starting cache warmup on model-medium in eu-west1 (warming prompts + kv prefill). approx 60s to see effect.
Samir P: PD note: creating incident checklist ticket INC-2026 -> #oncall-responses. keeping CS and support on standby.
pd-bot: Reminder: if unacked for 5m will escalate to SRE lead. (Currently ack'd by Samir P)
Jordan SRE: Alex — after routing override, can you drain pool-eu-3 gracefully and redeploy worker binary to pick up kernel fix?
Alex C: draining now:```kubectl drain deployment/gateway-proxy-eu-3 --grace-period=30 --timeout=300s```
Samir P: monitoring metrics — 2m after override error-rate in eu-west1 from 6.2% -> 2.1% overall but tail still spiking on large-seq requests.
Maria G: initial customer impact check: CS tool shows elevated errors for accounts: AcmeCorp (25% of their calls failing), BetaApps (10%). Not global but high for those customers.
Jordan SRE: escalate PD to page platform-eng lead if still >2% in 10m. For now, continue mitigation.
Alex C: drain completed, redeploy initiated on pool-eu-3:```deploy-bot: start redeploy gateway-proxy-eu-3 image=proxy:v2.14.1```
Alex C: redeploy logs show workers rejoined, no immediate OOMs.
Samir P: good sign. error rate trending down to 1.0% now. Latency normalizing.
Maria G: I'll open postmortem stub and capture CS communications: creating doc -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-PR
Jordan SRE: confirm rollback plan still ready? If error resurges, route-fallback -> full failover to eu fallback-region (eu-west2).
Samir P: agreed. notifying on-call rotation for 1-hr checkin. Will close PD alert once steady <0.5% for 15m and customer notifications sent.
pd-bot: Incident INC-2026 updated: acknowledged, status = investigating.
Alex C: final check: impact window ~02:38–02:54 UTC, primary cause: worker pool memory churn + cache warmup storm during concurrent long-sequence requests. mitigation: routing override + draining & redeploy + cache warmup. follow-ups: model warmup throttles, better mem-limits, per-customer rate shielding.
Samir P: thanks team. adding CS handoff notes and tagging support to proactively reach AcmeCorp and BetaApps. Will post final update in 15m unless anything changes. :white_check_mark:
